summary: Inspection closeout stages (Ed 2026-10-24). Adds stage columns to inspections (who completed the drive and when, inspected / violations identified / skipped counts, the skipped list, who completed the review and when, and closeout_tracked which is FALSE for every existing row) plus inspection_closeout_notices, the once-per-drive-per-day log for the 5 PM inspector reminder and the 8 AM Amanda flag. No UPDATE runs: no inspection, observation, violation or letter row changes.

preflight.name: inspections has no closeout columns yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'inspections' AND column_name IN ('closeout_tracked','completed_at','review_completed_at')

preflight.name: the notices table does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'inspection_closeout_notices'

expected_changes: inspections: 13 new columns (closeout_tracked boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, started_by_user_id, completed_at, completed_by_user_id, completed_by_name, inspected_property_count, violations_identified, skipped_property_count, skipped_properties, closeout_summary, review_completed_at, review_completed_by_user_id, review_completed_by_name). Existing rows read closeout_tracked = false and NULL for the rest.

inspections: four CHECK constraints (non-negative counts, completed actor present with completed_at, review actor present with review_completed_at, skipped list is an array) and one partial index for open tracked drives.
New empty table inspection_closeout_notices with a once-per-inspection-per-kind-per-day unique key and service_role SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE.
No rows change in inspections, property_observations, violations or interactions.

verify.name: every existing drive is untracked (no reminder flood)
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM inspections WHERE closeout_tracked

verify.name: new drives default to untracked until the API sets it
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'inspections' AND column_name = 'closeout_tracked' AND column_default = 'false' AND is_nullable = 'NO'

verify.name: the once-per-day guard exists
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'inspection_closeout_notices_once_per_day'
